content:
Dear all,

I am starting a new project with the goal of formalizing results in dispersive equations. We now
have a lot of the necessary ingredients to prove non-trivial results in partial differential
equations and there has been recurring interest in the topic, so I think it is worthwhile to have
some coordinated effort. I hope that this project helps to grow the number of contributors from
analysis to mathlib and provides a ground for experiments to formalize analysis in an ergonomic way.

The (rather empty) repository can be found here:
https://github.com/mcdoll/DispersiveEquations

Discussion: https://leanprover.zulipchat.com/#narrow/channel/113488-general/topic/Discussion.20for.20dispersive.20equations/with/619961706
@Moritz Doll don't hesitate to create a post in the Project board!
